principles: Reuse the W2a trust root: targetBindingDigest is canonDigest (W2a canon.ts), never a new canonicalizer.
One command owns the complete wiring recipe: land all 13 registration points on the cheapest command so four later commands inherit a mechanically-verified path.
Fail closed on identity: exactly one binding per target, createdAt stripped from the digest, out-of-expectedRedTargets rejected, foreign owner lease rejected.
Anti-swap by construction: authorize runs from the COMMITTED tree, never the live (editable) story directory.
Change no gate: this story adds a store + command; redEvidenceSatisfied/missingRedEvidence and every existing gate verdict stay identical.
drivers: The createdAt-strip digest direction is the behavioral trap: CANON over a stored entry (with createdAt) must NOT equal the digest; CANON over the 3-field subobject MUST.
The 13-point registration surface is enforced bidirectionally by three existing contracts that predate this story — every point must be present or the contracts fail with named divergences.
expectedRedTargets must be exported as a shared resolver WITHOUT changing its computed set (a pure extraction, provable by a same-set assertion).

options.name: Dedicated store leaf (target-bindings.ts) + handler + full 13-point wiring (chosen)
pros: Store logic (uniqueness, createdAt-strip digest, committed-tree reader) isolated and unit-testable
The complete wiring recipe is proven once and reused by four later commands
The three existing contracts mechanically verify every registration point
cons: Must get the createdAt-strip digest direction and all 13 points exactly right

options.name: Inline the store in the handler, register minimally
cons: No isolated store to unit-test the createdAt-strip trap
Later commands rediscover the 13-point surface each time
Contracts fail on any missed point — no benefit over doing it completely

chosen: Dedicated store leaf (target-bindings.ts) + handler + full 13-point wiring (chosen)
rationale: The store's identity rules (one-per-target, createdAt-stripped digest, committed-tree reader) are load-bearing and un-gameable, so they belong in an isolated, unit-tested leaf; and because the four later high-semantics commands (assert/green_confirm/quarantine/recover) all need the SAME owner-lease + mutation-authority + registration path, landing the complete 13-point recipe once on this lowest-semantics command — mechanically verified by the three pre-existing contracts — is strictly cheaper than each later command rediscovering it.

preMortem.scenario: createdAt-strip digest computed over the stored entry
preMortem.trigger: Implementer canonicalizes the whole stored binding (incl. createdAt) for the digest
preMortem.consequence: targetBindingDigest is unstable across writes and a green-confirm can never match a red-assert's digest
preMortem.mitigation: RED differential test asserts CANON over a STORED entry (with createdAt) does NOT equal the recorded digest while CANON over the 3-field subobject DOES

preMortem.trigger: One of the 13 wiring points (esp. the closed AgentDispatchMutationCommand union or a permittedMutations array) is not updated
preMortem.consequence: the command is un-dispatchable or un-authorized, or a contract fails
preMortem.mitigation: the three existing contracts (lifecycle-registry / command-ownership / verify-process-fact) are run in the smoke and fail with a named divergence until every point is present

preMortem.trigger: The export refactor accidentally alters the computed target set
preMortem.consequence: stories that used to have targets now differ — a silent behavior change
preMortem.mitigation: a same-set assertion proves the exported resolver returns the identical set for representative inputs

preMortem.scenario: The reader resolves from the live directory
preMortem.trigger: Implementer reads red-target-bindings.json from the working tree instead of the committed ref
preMortem.consequence: an uncommitted/post-review edit authorizes a run — the swap-after-review attack
preMortem.mitigation: a test where the committed tree and the live directory hold DIFFERENT bindings asserts the reader returns the committed one via git show

preMortem.trigger: The wiring inadvertently alters redEvidenceSatisfied/missingRedEvidence or a phase gate
preMortem.mitigation: the smoke asserts no existing gate verdict changes and CHK-009 pins this; the store+command add no gate evaluation
